config.description: Path to the unified configuration file (the single source of truth for this pipeline run).

setup_script.description: The path to the shell script that provisions the global environment.

execution_chain.description: The sequence of repositories to clone and execute.

order.description: The number in the sequence of execution.

repository_url.description: The full Git URL for the simulator repository.

version_tag.description: Git branch, tag, or commit hash to checkout.

input_file_name.description: The name of the target input file for this specific execution step.

output_file_name.description: The name of the expected output file generated by this execution step.

input_output_folder.description: The directory path where the step's input and output files reside.
